items.html: And we shall explain the matter of these two aspects, how they are done in these ten days; and the manner of the work of the sawing will also be well explained clearly. Behold, on the first day of Rosh HaShanah, which is the sixth day, on which Adam HaRishon was created, then the Lord cast a deep sleep upon ZA, in order to saw the Nukva standing at his back.
